title: Chevy K-series 6.2 diesel (CUCV M1008 / M1009): torques, capacities, idle, glow plugs
summary: Service numbers for the military 1984-87 Chevy K-series pickup and K5 Blazer (CUCV) with the 6.2L diesel, from the Army unit maintenance manual TM 9-2320-289-20: chassis and driveline torques, differential and coolant capacities, idle speeds and glow plug resistance.
warnings: These are the Army's numbers for the CUCV build (24-volt starting system, military wheels and axles). Check that a civilian truck has the same part before using a value.

specs.name: Engine
specs.value: 90-degree V8 diesel, 379 cu in (6.2 L), 135 hp @ 3,600 rpm (SAE net)

specs.name: Low idle
specs.note: Adjusted at the low idle screw on the injection pump, engine at operating temperature.

specs.name: Oil pan drain plug
specs.value: 20 ft-lb (27 N·m) at an oil change; PMCS check range 15-20 ft-lb

specs.name: Oil filter
specs.value: Oil the seal; one full turn after the seal contacts the block. Don't overtighten.

specs.name: Propeller shaft companion flange and U-joint screws
specs.value: 15 ft-lb (20 N·m); 25 ft-lb (34 N·m) where straps use 6-lobe bolts

specs.name: Spring U-bolt nuts
specs.value: 40 ft-lb (54 N·m) in an X pattern, then 150 ft-lb (203 N·m) front / 145 ft-lb rear in the same pattern

specs.name: Tie rod end replacement limit
specs.value: Socket moves 0.015 in (0.4 mm) on the ball stud

specs.name: Cargo body mounting bolts (all except M1009)
Wheel lug nuts
specs.value: 90 lb M1009; 140 lb all others (as printed in the PMCS table)

specs.name: Cooling system capacity
specs.value: 25 qt (23.7 L), 50/50 ethylene glycol and water; 65/35 below -10 °F (-25 °C)

specs.name: Differential service interval
specs.value: Drain and refill every 2 years or 24,000 miles

specs.name: Air filter element
specs.value: Normally annually or 12,000 miles; sooner in dust

body:
Left out on purpose: the transmission and transfer case service capacities and the torque converter cover bolt torque. In the scanned text their two units don't agree with each other (for example quarts vs. liters), so they need someone to check the printed page.

The tabulated data table (Table 1-1) lists weights, axle ratings and dimensions per model in columns that the OCR scrambles; only the engine line and fuel tank, which are the same for every model, are used here.

sources.title: TM 9-2320-289-20: Unit Maintenance Manual for Truck, Cargo, Tactical, 1-1/4 Ton, 4x4, M1008, M1008A1, M1009, M1010, M1028, M1028A1, M1031 (CUCV)

sources.citation: Table 1-1 Tabulated Data p. 1-8; Table 2-1 Unit PMCS items 8, 23-30 and 12-16, pp. 2-13 to 2-24.4; lubrication intervals p. 2-24.5; para. 3-4 Engine Oil and Oil Filter Replacement; para. 3-20 Glow Plug Replacement p. 3-61; para. 3-25 Engine Idle Speed Adjustment pp. 3-71 to 3-72
